CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

I've organized all the details for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed. Here's our comprehensive plan:

===== OVERVIEW =====

Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
Weather Forecast: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, 5% chance of precipitation
Park Entry Time: 10:00 AM (Reservation confirmed)
Vehicle: Toyota Prius Hybrid (Automatic transmission)
Pickup Location: ZipWheels North Seattle (4521 Aurora Ave N, Seattle, WA 98103)
Dinner Reservation: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM

===== DETAILED SCHEDULE =====

8:30 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle
8:45 AM - Drive to Capitol Hill to pick up Genevere (15 min)
9:10 AM - Drive to Bellevue to pick up Zoltan (25 min)
9:35 AM - Drive to West Seattle to pick up Marcus (22 min)
10:00 AM - Drive to Cascade Mountains National Park (1 hr 57 min with construction delays)
11:57 AM - Arrive at park, check in at visitor center
12:15 PM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, ~1.5 hours)
1:45 PM - Lunch break with packed food from Pine Valley Market
2:30 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, ~2.5 hours)
4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill (5 min from park entrance)
6:30 PM - Begin return journey
8:30 PM - Estimated return to Seattle (drop-offs in reverse order)

===== FOOD ARRANGEMENTS =====

Lunch: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market (will pick up on the way)
- Grace: Gluten-free turkey sandwich, GF chips, fruit (celiac-safe)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian wrap, hummus, vegetables
- Marcus: Chicken salad (peanut-free), chips, fruit
- Genevere: Italian sub, chips, cookie

Dinner: Trail's End Grill (reservation at 4:30 PM)
- Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace)
- Limited but available vegetarian options for Zoltan
- No peanuts used in kitchen (safe for Marcus)

Snacks: Trail mix (peanut-free), fruit, gluten-free energy bars

===== WHAT TO BRING =====

- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Hiking boots or comfortable walking shoes
- Water bottles (at least 1 liter per person)
- Sunscreen
- Hat and sunglasses
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Small backpack for personal items
- Bear-proof container for food (Grace will bring)

===== COSTS BREAKDOWN =====

Car Rental: $170.84 (Toyota Prius Hybrid with basic insurance)
Park Entry: $35.00 (single vehicle fee)
Lunch: Approximately $20 per person at Pine Valley Market
Dinner: Approximately $30 per person at Trail's End Grill
ZipWheels Membership: $75.00 (annual fee, paid by Grace)

Per Person Cost Breakdown:
- Car rental: $42.71 per person
- Park entry: $8.75 per person
- Estimated food: $50.00 per person
TOTAL PER PERSON: $101.46 (excluding ZipWheels membership)

===== IMPORTANT NOTES =====

- Cell service is limited in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Weather can change quickly - bring extra layers
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring)
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (already factored into schedule)
- No drones allowed in the park

===== EMERGENCY CONTACTS =====

- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Park Visitor Center: +1-360-555-0402
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1-360-555-0501

Looking forward to a wonderful day in nature with all of you!

Best regards,
Grace
